query:
SELECT 
    externalId,
    title,
    district,
    CAST(price AS DECIMAL(15,2)) as price_num,
    currency,
    bedrooms,
    CAST(area AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as area_num,
    propertyType
FROM properties
WHERE 
    district LIKE '%Surco%'
    AND isActive = 1
ORDER BY CAST(price AS DECIMAL(15,2)) ASC
LIMIT 20;
